verdict.rationale: EDD's own e-Services for Business page says employers can complete the core transactions online: registering an employer payroll tax account, filing and adjusting returns, and making payroll tax payments. The file-and-pay page adds that payments can be made without enrollment, via EFT/ACH or credit card. The 403 on the portal's robots.txt only blocks automated access and does not contradict these claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that an end-to-end registration, filing and payment flow works in the transactional portal.
